PUNJAB HEALTHCARE COMMISSION (PRICING OF HEALTHCARE
SERVICES) REGULATIONS, 2023
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
2nd March, 2023]
No.
PHC/NOT/2023/25, dated 28.2.2023.---In
exercise of the powers conferred under section 40 of the Punjab Healthcare
Commission Act, 2010 (Act XVI of 2010), the Punjab Healthcare Commission is
pleased to make the following Regulations:
Chapter I
General
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These Regulations may be called "The Punjab Healthcare Commission (Pricing
of Healthcare Services) Regulations, 2023".
(2) These
Regulations shall extend to the whole of the Punjab.
(3) These
Regulations shall come into force on such dates as specified, through
notification, by the Commission with respect to different categories and types
of healthcare establishments.
(4) These
Regulations .shall apply to all healthcare establishments, including but not
limited to public or private hospitals, diagnostic centers, non-profit
organizations, charitable hospitals, trust hospitals, semi-government and
autonomous healthcare establishment.
(5) Notwithstanding
anything contained in sub-regulation (4) above, the prices of healthcare
services being provided at public sector healthcare establishments shall be
determined and notified by the relevant authorities, controlling and
administering such healthcare establishments.
(6) Pricing
mechanism as provided in Chapter III of these Regulations shall apply to
healthcare establishments of Categories I, II and such healthcare
establishments of Category III, as laid down in the Punjab Healthcare
Commission Licensing Regulations, 2020, providing diagnostic/imaging services,
day care surgeries and interventional procedures or such other healthcare
services as notified by the Commission from time to time.
(7) Notwithstanding
what has been stated in sub-regulation (6), the Prices for healthcare
establishment other than as mentioned in sub-regulation (6) shall be determined
by the Commission in consultation with the relevant stake holders.
2. Definitions.---(1) In these Regulations, unless there is
anything repugnant to the subject or context the following expressions shall
have the meanings given as under:-
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act, 2010;
(b) "Ancillary
Facilities" means and include any offered and/or provided by
healthcare establishment which is not directly covered under the meaning of
healthcare services, but, are ancillary or connected to provision of healthcare
services.
(c) "Board"
shall have the same meaning as given in the Punjab Healthcare Commission Act,
2010;
(d) "Complainant"
means and include any person whether himself aggrieved or not who files a
Complaint pertaining to pricing of healthcare services and/or services
ancillary thereto before the Commission or any other Committee or Officer
notified for the purposes of receiving and dealing with Complaints under these
Regulations;
(e) "Commonly
Undertaken Procedures" means and include all healthcare services
and/or procedures which are commonly carried out at healthcare establishments
including but not limited to, consultation, OPD procedures, IPD procedures,
Laboratory Services, imaging Services, etc. and notified by the Commission as
such from time to time.
(f) "Hearing
Committee" means the Committee comprising of one or more member(s) to
be nominated by the Commission.
(g) "Pricing
Cell/Department" means the Pricing Cell/Department
notified/established by the Commission pursuant to these Regulations.
(h) "Cost"
means the actual cost incurred by a healthcare establishment for providing any
healthcare service including services ancillary thereto, as determined in
accordance with these Regulations;
(i) "Other
procedures" means healthcare services and/or procedures other than
commonly undertaken procedures;
